posts.title: BASS 2026: Saïd Sayrafiezadeh, “Nocturnal Creatures” from The New Yorker, 5/5/25
posts.description: The inspiration for this story was quite simple: phobia. Specifically my own phobia. Specifically towards cockroaches. Perhaps all stories – or at least mine – are at their essence about some kind of fear.… The narrator is the exterminator, who, of course, is the opposite of me. He is the man I aspire to be. […]
